description: Pull Request creation flow based on GitHub flow. Use whenever the user wants to open a PR, create a pull request, "PR を作って", merge feature work into main, or prepare changes for review. The skill walks through commit history checks, fills the repo's `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`, picks an appropriate label, and runs `gh pr create --base main`. It does not handle release tagging — for that see the release-tag skill.
